sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "t_ai_oracle_trigger"() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $oracle$ BEGIN INSERT INTO log VALUES(new.id, new.v); IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $oracle$
CREATE TRIGGER "t_ai" AFTER INSERT ON t FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION "t_ai_oracle_trigger"()
